outstanding_items: RESOLVED THIS MORNING — the OpenReply verification question that has been repeated for five consecutive mornings is now answered. The uncommitted diff DOES NOT COMPILE. Baseline typecheck at HEAD (194f88f, run in a detached worktree) produces 24 errors; the working tree produces 28. The diff introduces exactly 4 new TypeScript errors: (1) lib/queue/dm-worker.ts:617 TS2552 'Cannot find name commentId' — the diff swapped the DM recipient argument from userId to commentId, which is not in scope inside processPostback; (2) lib/queue/dm-worker.ts:633 TS2353 'trackedLinks does not exist in type' — renderMessageWithoutLink in lib/tracking/message.ts accepts only { message, commenterName }, so the trackedLinks: [] property is invalid; (3) and (4) components/campaign-builder.tsx:405 and :408 TS2304 'Cannot find name normalizeUrl' — the helper is called twice but was never written; a grep across all .ts/.tsx outside node_modules finds only the two call sites and no definition.

SEPARATE LOGIC HAZARD not caught by the typechecker — the diff deletes the 'return;' that previously terminated the follow-prompt branch. The follow-gate block now falls through into the normal quota/send path below (reserveWorkspaceDMSend), so a non-follower would receive the follow prompt AND then the reward link in the same run, defeating the follow gate entirely. The else branch that sends the reward DM also does not return, creating a probable double-send. This needs a correctness decision, not just a type fix.
